title: Illustrated cover: War Department Intelligence Review No. 47, 9 Jan 1947
description: Printed illustrated cover of the SECRET War Department Intelligence Review Number 47 (9 January 1947) — a tilted title card over an engraved Army eagle-and-star emblem, with SECRET banners, Copy No. 597, handwritten accession number 959,328, RECORDED and 20 Jan 1947 date stamps, and declassification stamp. This issue carries the 'Ghost Rockets over Scandinavia' feature.
